sources.title: Faster Whisper – Fast and Accurate AI Speech-to-Text Software
sources.snippet: Faster Whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using the high-performance CTranslate2 runtime. It delivers the same trusted speech-to-text accuracy while running dramatically faster and lighter — making professional transcription possible on everyday hardware.
